# Earnings Calendar. But savvy investors know there are key events that can impact stock prices – and earnings reports are one of the biggest. This is where the earnings calendar comes in. Think of an earnings calendar as your roadmap to upcoming company financial reports. The earnings calendar lists these reports by company, date, and sometimes even estimated earnings per share (EPS). ## Why is the Earnings Calendar Important? Earnings reports offer a window into a company's financial health. By tracking the earnings calendar, you can:. You can filter them by date, industry, or company to find the information most relevant to you. By understanding the earnings calendar and using it strategically, you can gain valuable insights into the stock market and make more informed investment decisions.
